atoms.exact_source_text: At Home, a Citizen is an individually accounted-for unit of commitment. Away, a Citizen is an individually resolved unit of capability.
atoms.normalized_claim: Doctrine: at Home a Citizen is an individually accounted-for unit of commitment; Away, a Citizen is an individually resolved unit of capability.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Colony       | DWELL    | Home                     | Maintains Roles, Places, Projects, Conditions, and Readiness.                                           |
atoms.normalized_claim: Colony register maps to DWELL verb, primarily available at Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: Maintains Roles, Places, Projects, Conditions, and Readiness.
atoms.normalized_claim: Colony/DWELL maintains Roles, Places, Projects, Conditions, and Readiness.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Field        | TRAVEL   | Away                     | Carries Citizens through distance and environmental drag.                                               |
atoms.normalized_claim: Field register maps to TRAVEL verb, primarily available Away.

atoms.exact_source_text: Carries Citizens through distance and environmental drag.
atoms.normalized_claim: Field/TRAVEL carries Citizens through distance and environmental drag.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Crossing     | RISK     | Away                     | Resolves immediate spatial panic and traffic-scale hazard.                                              |
atoms.normalized_claim: Crossing register maps to RISK verb, primarily available Away.

atoms.exact_source_text: Resolves immediate spatial panic and traffic-scale hazard.
atoms.normalized_claim: Crossing/RISK resolves immediate spatial panic and traffic-scale hazard.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Encounter    | MEET     | Home and Away            | Stages any bounded consequential situation: storm, collapse, stranger, predator, discovery, or dispute. |
atoms.normalized_claim: Encounter register maps to MEET verb, primarily available in both Home and Away.

atoms.exact_source_text: Stages any bounded consequential situation: storm, collapse, stranger, predator, discovery, or dispute.
atoms.normalized_claim: Encounter/MEET stages any bounded consequential situation such as storm, collapse, stranger, predator, discovery, or dispute.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Embodiment   | EMBODY   | Home only                | Makes successful sanctuary perceptible through guided Citizen-scale experience.                         |
atoms.normalized_claim: Embodiment register maps to EMBODY verb, available Home only.

atoms.exact_source_text: Makes successful sanctuary perceptible through guided Citizen-scale experience.
atoms.normalized_claim: Embodiment/EMBODY makes successful sanctuary perceptible through guided Citizen-scale experience.

atoms.exact_source_text: DWELL establishes order -\> Citizens leave -\> AWAY creates exposure -\> Citizens return -\> DWELL restores equilibrium -\> EMBODY makes safety felt
atoms.normalized_claim: The Home Loop cycle proceeds: DWELL establishes order, Citizens leave, AWAY creates exposure, Citizens return, DWELL restores equilibrium, EMBODY makes safety felt.

atoms.exact_source_text: The colony is the Home crunch subject.
atoms.normalized_claim: The colony, not the individual, is the Home crunch subject.

atoms.exact_source_text: Domestic calculations operate globally.
atoms.normalized_claim: Domestic calculations operate at the global colony level.

atoms.exact_source_text: Individual names remain attached to assignments, absence, advice, memory, and availability without becoming productivity multipliers.
atoms.normalized_claim: Individual names stay attached to assignments, absence, advice, memory, and availability but do not become productivity multipliers.

atoms.exact_source_text: A stable colony can actually be stable.
atoms.normalized_claim: A stable colony can genuinely achieve stability.

atoms.exact_source_text: Adequate Capacity fully covers routine Load.
atoms.normalized_claim: Adequate Capacity fully covers routine Load.

atoms.exact_source_text: The system does not manufacture daily chores merely to preserve engagement.
atoms.normalized_claim: The system does not manufacture daily chores merely to preserve engagement.

atoms.exact_source_text: Competence creates quiet.
atoms.normalized_claim: Competence creates quiet.

atoms.exact_source_text: The reward for sound stewardship is a broad plateau of safety in which Projects, observation, EMBODY, and ordinary Citizen life can occur.
atoms.normalized_claim: Sound stewardship rewards players with a broad plateau of safety enabling Projects, observation, EMBODY, and ordinary Citizen life.

atoms.exact_source_text: Global abstraction is a strength.
atoms.normalized_claim: Global abstraction is treated as a strength.

atoms.exact_source_text: Diffuse structural wear, care work, storage attention, and watchfulness are colony postures.
atoms.normalized_claim: Diffuse structural wear, care work, storage attention, and watchfulness are classified as colony postures.

atoms.exact_source_text: They need not be simulated as hundreds of tiny local tasks.
atoms.normalized_claim: Colony postures need not be simulated as hundreds of tiny local tasks.

atoms.exact_source_text: Important consequences become local.
atoms.normalized_claim: Important consequences become local.

atoms.exact_source_text: When an abstract vulnerability matters enough to become a story, MEET places it in a specific zone, Place, household, route, or relationship.
atoms.normalized_claim: When an abstract vulnerability matters enough to become a story, MEET localizes it to a specific zone, Place, household, route, or relationship.

atoms.exact_source_text: Shortfall is vulnerability, not automatic punishment.
atoms.normalized_claim: Shortfall represents vulnerability rather than automatic punishment.

atoms.exact_source_text: Insufficient coverage raises the likelihood and stakes of a fitting Colony Encounter instead of applying a constant stack of unrelated debuffs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Insufficient coverage raises the likelihood and stakes of a fitting Colony Encounter rather than applying a constant stack of unrelated debuffs.

atoms.exact_source_text: Spatial identity is mechanical identity.
atoms.normalized_claim: Spatial identity is mechanical identity.

atoms.exact_source_text: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT alter Load, resilience, failure geometry, and lived experience.
atoms.normalized_claim: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT alter Load, resilience, failure geometry, and lived experience.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home survives; Away enables advancement.
atoms.normalized_claim: Home supports survival while Away enables advancement.

atoms.exact_source_text: Local ecology and ordinary Practices support continued life.
atoms.normalized_claim: Local ecology and ordinary Practices support continued life at Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: Exceptional materials, knowledge, access, and growth arrive through Expeditions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Exceptional materials, knowledge, access, and growth arrive through Expeditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Player attention is a protected resource.
atoms.normalized_claim: Player attention is treated as a protected resource.

atoms.exact_source_text: The interface should settle at Dawn, explain what changed, and then grant permission to linger without real-time deterioration.
atoms.normalized_claim: The interface should settle at Dawn, explain what changed, and then grant permission to linger without real-time deterioration.
